newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport plunges on tax refund refusal.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport plunges on tax refund refusal.

text.p: Shares in Polish steel trader Stalexport SA fell 9.9 percent to 45.5 zlotys and did not trade after price fixing due to excessive supply following a court ruling that denied it a 75 million zlotys tax refund.
"Everone expected today's fall," one trader said.
Traders said, however, they did not expect panic selling and that any further falls next week should be less severe than Friday's plunge.
A branch of the Supreme Administrative Court (NSA) on Thursday rejected Stalexport's claim that the treasury should refund it 75 million zlotys in interest on tax allegedly overpaid in 1989-1990.
